steps.title: Independent verification of the B4 round-2 fix (coin taps, lift cap, toast avoidance, swap search, texts)
steps.instructions:
The B4 round-2 fix (report: key B4_fix2 = key B4r3_impl; the review it answers: key B4_review2; the round-1 review: key B4_review) was never reviewed: the runner stops after two rounds. It changed core input: camera_rig.gd now emits hex_tapped(cell, screen); main._on_hex_tapped(c, screen) collects when map_view.bubble_at(screen) hits a visible coin, before the ground pick; map_view._bubble_lift caps the lift at every zoom (share 0.40 default, 0.33 close); coins hide under the live toast (map_view.toast_rect = ui.toast_rect); _swap_shape split into _swap_salients/_swap_exclaves; busy free-finish CTA «Бесплатно»/«Free»; hex_scorched cracks rebuilt; compose_keyart value_of(). Its probes are in scratchpad/playtest/fix/B4/fix2/ (rv8–rv10, swap_eq, tapmini) — reuse them.
Verify everything it claims (re-measure, do not trust its numbers) and above all hunt input regressions of the new coin hit-test: (1) FTUE — every coach step that asks the player to tap a hex (capital, target, colonize, march…) while a coin of that or a neighbouring hex covers the spot: the step must still advance (play the tutorial with the playtest drivers in scratchpad/playtest/A/drv and B/drv, ru and en); (2) war target picking, march pick, swap pick, colonize pick, tower/fort placement — a tap meant for a hex must not collect a coin instead (check precedence in _on_hex_tapped and the coach/targeting modes); (3) drags and pinches that start or end on a coin must never collect; long press; a tap during the camera glide; (4) battle and ceremony — no coin hit-test while coins are hidden; (5) tall 941×2091 and std 941×1672; (6) a tap on the «+N» label and the coin's top edge; (7) bubble_at cost (only on tap, no per-frame allocations); (8) the swap search: same chosen package as before (swap_eq), and timing; (9) texts: «Бесплатно» fits RU/EN at all card widths, toasts. Tests green (test_flow, test_siblings, the suites the diff touches), ui_lint, check_strings. Report ok=true only if no high/medium issue remains.
steps.verify: probe logs and tap tables; FTUE playthrough shots ru/en; precedence table per mode; test logs

steps.title: UI and portrait low issues left by T1/T2 (fan label over mouths, chip headgear, toast safe inset, docs, QA, tests)
steps.instructions:
Read keys T1_portrait_ui_review2 and T2_face_crops_hero_chests_review (all their low issues, with the evidence paths). Fix, verifying each in the code first (say so where a note is wrong):
1. «Армия» tab, «Командиры» fan card (58×70 pictures): with the face crop the card's name label covers mouths and chins (Lira, Bram, Rai — review/cmp_fan.png). Make every face fully readable above the label: move the label, shift the crop, or use the bust for this slot — decide by side-by-side screenshots of all 12 in E1 and E4.
2. Army card chip Ø38 (Kit._card_ring): the face crop with the (-5,-6) lift cuts tall headgear (Kort E2 colpack, Vega E2 bicorne, Bram E2 shako badge — review/chip_sim*.png). Keep the head ≥ 28 px and the headgear whole (per-commander/era offset or headgear-aware scale); check all 12 × 4 eras in a simulated sheet and in game.
3. Picker 72 / calendar 64: headgear tips touch the 2 px rarity frame/18 px corner (Vance all eras, Bram E2, Vega E2) — give them ≥ 2 px clearance.
4. Toast lifted over a modal title with a top safe inset (immersive_mode, T = 48/72/96 px): the toast must never cover the window title; a lifted two-line toast that cannot fit above the plate (pass, album) goes to the bottom safe area instead of colliding with the plate/medal frame. Probe T = 0/48/72/96 at 941×1672 and 941×2091.
5. tools/blender/portrait_kit/rig.py solve_frame face mode: the error path formats t['side_band'] (None) and raises TypeError instead of the 'does not fit' RuntimeError — fix the message.
6. Unit test (game/tests, add to the CI list if there is one) for the cmd_portrait face path: _render_face returns a face for the 12×4 calm files and Bram's smiles, null for leaders and non-Bram smiles (bust drawn), _sync_era clears the face entries.
7. QA/docs sync: tools/qa_portraits/qa_common.py RULER_PLATES → the shipped HUD crest plate colours (('#A3D6F4', '#8FCDF2') or whatever hud.gd ships now — check); diplomacy ldr_* busts (92×106) get mipmaps (imports + filter) if they are drawn scaled; docs/ui_style.md §3.1 lists the lifted toast's CanvasLayer 4; docs/art_direction.md §7.12/§7.14 numbers match a fresh qa_contrast --face run (rim B passes/fails, beard-clothes fails) and the real render budget.
8. Optional if cheap: Seir E1/E2 face crops have worse rim contrast than the bust (37/35 % vs 28/27 %, 45/49 % vs 40/41 %) — re-render those 2–4 files with a tweak that brings them to the bust's level, or document why not.
Verify: before/after screenshots and zoomed crops of every touched slot (commanders:tab fan E1/E4, army chip, picker, calendar, calendar:pick, toast over album/pass at each inset), draw counts per screen (≤ current + 2), the new test, test_flow, test_siblings, ui_lint, check_strings, qa_portraits runs.
steps.verify: before/after pairs + crops; inset probe table; draw counts; new unit test + test_flow PASS; QA logs

steps.title: Strategic map performance back under budget, apply the art pass 6 map patches, small map fixes
steps.instructions:
1. Apply art pass 6's map patches: read every report JSON in scratchpad/polish/AP6_art_pass6/ (report_impl, report_review, report_fix, report_review2, report_fix2 — the newest fix/impl report is authoritative; reviews may name more placement problems) and the followup_*.patch files there; apply what is right to the current map_view.gd (re-locate if lines moved), skip and explain what is wrong.
2. Performance: the strategic chapter II overview (--demo=ch2:view) costs 476 draws (3D 253 + shadow 154 = 407) and the DL8 battle 466 (282 + 112 = 394) against the ~330 3D+shadow budget (measured in Z1_art_followups_review). Measure where the draws go (per node type: forests/props/buildings/troops/borders/water; shadow casters), then bring both views and the std set (tools/soft_shots.sh strat z03 close dl8 cer sel battle) to ≤ 330 without visible loss at the zoom each view is seen at: e.g. no shadows from small props/grass/rocks at strategic zoom (GeometryInstance3D.cast_shadow by size or visibility_range), MultiMesh merging of repeated props per material, visibility ranges/LOD by camera zoom, merged static meshes per hex. Before/after perf table for every std view + ch2:view, ch3:view if it exists, battle at DL1/DL5/DL8, tall 941×2091; before/after screenshots at strat/mid/close to prove no visible regression; look_metrics on the std set.
3. Dark lake hex with a tower (player-owned dark lake): _place_tower puts the tower at about r 0.55, inside the baked oil surface (reaches x 0.61, z -0.52, random turn) — place it on the rim (rotate the lake or pick a free rim spot), verify with a demo (add one if missing).
4. tools/godot_shot.sh / main.gd _shot: the minimum wait after a chapter demo (`create_timer(maxf(delay, 1.5))`) does not cover the hex panel's bake (no --shot-delay gives canvas 176 vs 71 with delay 3) although the comment and how_to_run.md 5b say it does — make the wait real (wait for the bake) or fix the comment and docs.
5. docs/dev/backlog.md: add the art pass 6 tails the reviewers left open (if any) as one item; mark what this step finished.
Verify: perf tables, before/after shots of every touched view, test_flow, ui_lint, check_strings.
steps.verify: perf before/after table (≤ 330 on strat/battle); before/after shots strat/mid/close; patch list applied/skipped; tower-on-lake shot; test_flow
